description: This file defines a custom color picker dialog component for Android, including a view for selecting colors via touch interaction and handling related color computations.

classes.name: ColorPickerDialog
classes.description: A dialog that displays a color wheel for users to select a color. It contains an inner class 'ColorPickerView' for custom rendering and touch handling of the color wheel.

classes.name: ColorPickerDialog.OnColorChangedListener
classes.description: Interface for callback when the user has selected a color.

classes.name: ColorPickerView
classes.description: A custom View that displays a color wheel and handles user interaction to select colors.

methods.name: ColorPickerDialog.<init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing the color picker dialog with context, listener, and initial color.

methods.name: ColorPickerDialog.onCreate
methods.description: Creates the dialog's view and sets it up with a color change listener.

methods.name: ColorPickerView.<init>
methods.description: Initializes the color wheel view with context, listener, and starting color.

methods.name: ColorPickerView.onDraw
methods.description: Draws the color wheel and center circle, including highlight effects.

methods.name: ColorPickerView.onMeasure
methods.description: Sets the dimensions of the view based on constants.
